access.raw_byte_range_on_opendap_file_path: HTTP 416 (no plain byte-range read); getfile 416; obdaac-tea cumulus 302 to urs.earthdata.nasa.gov
access.subsetting_works: DAP4 hyperslab constraint on lat/lon/wavelength works anonymously (single pixel, 12 bands: 21.6 kB, 0.6 s)

files_per_day_dir: plus NRT variants; 8D and MO composites

variables.rhos: float32 [lat, lon, wavelength] (WAVELENGTH LAST), long_name 'Surface reflectance', _FillValue -32767.0, valid_min -0.05, valid_max 1.5, no scale/offset, zlib level 4, chunks [8,1024,5] in the DAP4 response

q1_level3_sfrefl.grid: lat descending 89.97917..-89.97917, lon -179.97917..179.97917 (pixel centres) - identical to pace4k/oc4k
q1_level3_sfrefl.flags_applied_at_binning: l2_flag_names = ATMFAIL,CLDICE,HIGLINT,HILT,HISATZEN,HISOLZEN; no per-pixel flag variable carried

granules_cmr.nrt: V3_1 NRT daily files present on OPeNDAP to 2026-10-10 (directory 2026/1011 exists)

values_2025_07_01.note: rhos is valid on 94% of pixels where BGC chlor_a is valid; chlor_a is valid on only 24.6% of rhos-valid pixels - SFREFL keeps far more (land, bright/turbid, edges)

q1_level2_sfrefl.collection: PACE_OCI_L2_SFREFL C3620139902-OB_CLOUD v3.1 'Level-2 Regional Surface Reflectance'
q1_level2_sfrefl.access: CMR anonymous; download obdaac-tea 302 -> Earthdata login; not on anonymous OPeNDAP (PACE_OCI/L2 404)

q2_alternatives.RRS: wavelength 172 bands 346..719 nm - confirmed, no NIR/SWIR
q2_alternatives.LANDVI: 4320x8640 indices only: ndvi, evi, ndwi, ndii, cci, ndsi, pri, cire, car, mari - no reflectance bands
q2_alternatives.flags: none carried per pixel in L3; masking by the six l2 flags above at binning (HIGLINT removes sun glint)

q3_licence.attribution: NASA Ocean Biology Processing Group (2024-2026). PACE OCI Level-3 Global Mapped Surface Reflectance Data, version 3.1 (doi:10.5067/PACE/OCI/L3M/SFREFL/3.1). NASA Goddard Space Flight Center, Ocean Ecology Laboratory, Ocean Biology Distributed Active Archive Center.

design.tier: G sharded, pace4k's grid (4320x8640, 1/24 deg, row 0 north), tile 256, zstd 15, F=5 daily frames per bin

fetch.hosted_runner: NOT measured; at the sandbox rate a year is ~14 h serial, ~4.7 h with 3 workers (pace4k's WORKERS); split by year across jobs
fetch.memory: frame [4320,8640,6] float32 = 0.9 GB; the 5-band response decodes to 0.75 GB float32

design.optional_bands_unmeasured: 645 (FAI baseline) and 739/742 (FDI red-edge baseline) are in the same cube at index 56 and 85/86; each extra single-band request ~43 MB/~47 s by analogy with 865 - not fetched

native_pixel_reread.result: independent DAP4 single-pixel request returned identical float32 values for all 6 bands (exact)

clear_water_dark_swir.test: over pixels where BGC chlor_a is valid, median rhos(2258) < 0.01 and p99 < 0.03 (measured 0.0052 / 0.0217)

aerosol_consistency.note: only r=0.43 - weak; consistent with rhos being Rayleigh/gas-corrected but NOT aerosol-corrected (aerosol path dominates open-ocean rhos at 865); use as a sign test (slope>0), not a tight check

falsifiers.rrs865: not possible: Rrs stops at 719 nm

not_measured: whether rhos is aerosol-corrected (inferred from data, not read from documentation)
whether SFREFL V3_1 refined lags ~6 weeks (inferred from last refined 2026-08-31 vs NRT 2026-10-10)
a multi-day store-size spread (one day only)
